covers.name: 01-water-ripples.png
covers.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Xiaohongshu video cover, portrait 3:4 aspect ratio, ideally 1536x2048. This is promotional cover design for the user's actual tranquil tactile nature game named 片刻. Use supplied screenshots as accurate visual assets, preserve their distinctive low-poly 3D game appearance and actual scene shapes. This is an editorial cover composition, NOT a new fantasy scene. No Zelda/Hyrule text, no characters, no phones, no hands, no invented features, no logos, no watermarks. Remove screenshot mouse cursors, toolbars and small original UI text. Text must be elegant, clear, exactly the Chinese provided, soft handwritten literary Kai typography inspired by LXGW WenKai, large enough for a small mobile thumbnail. Essential title and imagery concentrated between 15% and 74% canvas height. Keep bottom 22% calm negative space without text for platform overlays, generous top breathing room. Professional quiet art direction, restrained pale-gold/ivory typography and deep forest green from the game.
Input image 1 is the actual water-game visual to preserve. Design A: immersive turquoise water ripples. Full-bleed top-down pond image, preserve original luminous circular ripples surrounding the submerged stone at upper left, visible floating golden leaves and dim fish, stone shore at outer margins. Deep green softly shaded bottom. Main headline in two spacious left-aligned lines in middle-right of upper half: 「指尖落下」 then 「一池温柔」. Put only the smaller subtitle 「水面模拟器」 under the headline. Small airy brand 「片刻」 near upper margin. Do not place text over the bright ripple center. The pond's real concentric ripple rings are a key focal point. Crisp restrained print-like typography, no stickers or outlines.
